title: UFO whistleblower says he saw footage of bizarre alien species including ones like "Greek gods"
excerpt: Just when one thought that UFO stories couldn't get any wilder, whistleblower David Grusch spilled some bombshell claims on the Joe Rogan podcast. Grusch, a retired US Air Force intelligence officer and National Reconnaissance Office representative to the UAP Task Force, claimed that he has seen audio-video footage of alien species that travelled in differently shaped UFOs.
content:
Archi Biswas

Updated Sun, October 4, 2026 at 9:26 AM UTC

Just when one thought that UFO stories couldn't get any wilder, whistleblower David Grusch spilled some bombshell claims on the Joe Rogan podcast. Grusch, a retired US Air Force intelligence officer and National Reconnaissance Office representative to the UAP Task Force, claimed that he has seen audio-video footage of alien species that travelled in differently shaped UFOs.

What stood out most from his claims was his description of beings that resembled Greek gods, 7-foot-tall reptiles, and small gray aliens. Grusch claimed that he learned about these accounts while working with the UAP Task Force in 2020. During his appearance on Joe Rogan's podcast, he claimed to see footage of military personnel at the contemporary UFO crash site where they allegedly discovered four dead alien bodies. Grusch described them as:

"Human like in form and appeared to be like Greek Gods."

"I know it sounds schizo": UFO whistleblower David Grusch talks about Greek god and gorilla-reptile shaped aliens

While speaking about aliens on Joe Rogan's podcast, Grusch said,

"I'm like, I cannot believe I'm talking about this on Joe Rogan. And I mean, I know it sounds schizo."

However, he also believes that one day the truth will be revealed. During Joe Rogan's podcast, he clarified that he never personally witnessed the phenomenon of encountering alien beings himself. However, he claimed that he did see classified audio-video footage related to the government operations.

"I got to see the audio visual on that. It's contemporary."

Grusch claimed he saw footage of the crash retrieval event, including footage of deceased non-human cadavers. He claimed the deceased beings looked quite human-like and were pale bluish-white in color. Speaking about the aliens, Grusch said that they were very beautiful and resembled Greek gods.

The former US Air Force intelligence officer said that he was shown the footage as part of his investigation.

Grusch also spoke about aliens that resembled a gorilla-reptile. He claimed that some of his colleagues saw these creatures alive. The UFO whistleblower said that he never saw them in person, but his colleagues described the creatures as

"Seven foot tall plus gorilla-looking...scaly skin though."

He also mentioned that the officials found living reptilians and dead grays at a crash site, a finding which might be evidence of conflict between different types of non-human entities. He claimed that the small grays might have clashed with the reptilian creatures. He said that the reptilians were allegedly piloting the so-called Tic Tac UFO, similar to the one that Commander David Fravor encountered in 2004 off the San Diego coast. (via New York Post)

According to a New York Post report, Grusch said that the reptilian aliens were taken out because they had killed US military personnel at the site. When Joe Rogan asked what happened to the living reptilians in the crash, Grusch said that they were shot and killed.

The UFO whistleblower, David Grusch, also spoke about different types of crafts that the alien creatures use. He claimed,

"So obviously there has been physical craft of all different flavors like I’ve talked about. You know the Tic Tacs are real. There’s eggs. There’s different types of discs. There’s boot heels...sunfish looking things. Boomerangs, crescent moon-looking craft as well."

According to a report by Fox News in June 2026, David Grusch accused intelligence agencies of hiding billions of dollars in secret government activities outside normal oversight channels. Grusch, who served at the Pentagon's Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force, gained attention in 2023 when he testified before Congress about government efforts to study unidentified crafts.
